raft.k: A biotech giant with secret labs
st: Oscorp's lab breeds the spider that bites Peter, and Rajit Ratha pushes Dr. Connors to test his lizard formula on people.
Its eel lab turns Max Dillon into Electro, Menken seizes the company from Harry, and its armor makes Sytsevich the Rhino.
The Life Foundation's probe brings symbiotes to Earth, and Carlton Drake tests them on homeless people in San Francisco.
Venom wrecks the launch that would bring more symbiotes to Earth, and Drake dies with Riot.
Kingpin's Alchemax builds a collider under the city to reach other universes, and Olivia Octavius guards its secrets.
Miles throws Kingpin into the kill switch, the collider is destroyed, and Kingpin's team is arrested.
The Spot, an Alchemax scientist scarred by the collider, raids Alchemax labs in other universes to grow stronger.
In season 2, Kingpin hires six of Spider-Man's foes as the Insidious Six, who unmask him but are fooled and later beaten.
In season 5, Kingpin reunites the Six, with the Vulture in Mysterio's place, to hunt the Six American Warriors' rings.
In season 5, Silver Sable's Wild Pack seize an informant in Moscow, then capture Spider-Man, Kingpin and the Insidious Six.
Freed by Spider-Man from the Red Skull's trap, Sable turns and helps him.

raft.k: Doctor Octopus's band of Spider-Man's foes
st: In season 1, with Electro's help, Doctor Octopus breaks four foes out of Ryker's as the Sinister Six, and Spider-Man beats them all.
In season 2, the Master Planner re-forms the Six with Mysterio and Kraven and kidnaps Gwen, until Spider-Man stops them.
On Counter-Earth, the High Evolutionary's animal knights and his Machine Men keep the humans down and hunt Spider-Man.
Big Donovan's gang drafts Lonnie Lincoln into a turf war with the Scorpions, and Lonnie ends up leading it.
Mac Gargan's Scorpions war with the 110th for turf, until Spider-Man and Lonnie beat Gargan and he is arrested.
In 1933, Silvermane's mob rules New York's underworld and adds powered enforcers like Flint Marko and Megawatt.
The Spider fights its metahumans, and Cat Hardy kills Silvermane.

raft.k: Sebastian Shaw's secret society of mutants
st: In 1962, Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club, with Emma Frost, Azazel and Riptide, pushes the superpowers toward nuclear war.
Erik kills Shaw off Cuba, and Azazel and Riptide go over to Erik.
Erik leaves Charles with Raven, Angel, Azazel and Riptide, and they break Emma Frost out of prison.
Magneto's Brotherhood, with Mystique, Sabretooth and Toad, kidnaps Rogue to power a mutation machine on Liberty Island.
The X-Men wreck the machine, and Magneto ends up in a plastic prison.
Mystique frees Magneto, who sides with the X-Men against Stryker, wins Pyro over, then turns Cerebro on humans.
Magneto raises a new Brotherhood against the mutant cure and frees Juggernaut and Multiple Man from a prison convoy.
The X-Men beat his army on Alcatraz, and Beast injects Magneto with the cure.

raft.k: William Stryker's secret program to turn mutants into weapons
st: Major Stryker leads Team X, then his Weapon X program laces Logan's bones with adamantium and builds Weapon XI.
Logan and Victor bring down Weapon XI, the captive mutants escape, and the Army detains Stryker for questioning.
Stryker raids Xavier's school and builds a second Cerebro at his Alkali Lake base to kill every mutant.
The X-Men stop his Cerebro, the dam bursts and kills Stryker, and his files go to the President.
In 1983, Stryker's soldiers take Hank, Raven, Peter and Moira to Alkali Lake, and Jean frees his caged Weapon X.
Dying Ichiro Yashida lures Logan to Japan, and his son Shingen plots with the Yakuza to seize the company from Mariko.
Yashida, alive inside the Silver Samurai, tries to take Logan's healing, but Logan kills him and Mariko takes over.
Two years after Japan, a Trask Industries commercial plays at Logan's airport as Magneto warns him of a new weapon.
In 1973, Trask Industries experiments on captured mutants and wins Nixon's approval for its Sentinel program.
Mystique spares Trask, the Sentinel program is shut down, and Trask is arrested for selling military secrets.
In ancient Egypt, En Sabah Nur's Four Horsemen watch as crowds chant his name and he raises pyramids.
In 3600 BC, traitors entomb En Sabah Nur, and his four Horsemen die defending him.
In 1983, he empowers Storm, Psylocke, Angel and Magneto as new Horsemen, and they kidnap Xavier.
Angel dies in a crash, Psylocke flees, and Storm and Magneto turn on Apocalypse.
Vuk's shape-shifting D'Bari come to Earth to take the cosmic force from Jean and use it to conquer the planet.
Jean destroys the D'Bari on the train and carries Vuk into space to die.

raft.k: A biotech company that breeds mutant children
st: In 2029, Transigen breeds children from mutant DNA as weapons, and Pierce's Reavers hunt Laura when she escapes.
Logan kills Dr. Rice, the children kill Pierce and the Reavers, and Laura shoots X-24.

raft.k: A shadowy company with an interest in mutants
st: In 1983, vials of Weapon X's blood go into a briefcase belonging to the Essex Corporation.
An orphanage owned by the Essex Corporation abuses young mutants like Russell, and its headmaster ends up dead.
Essex runs the hidden hospital where Dr. Reyes holds five young mutants and orders Dani killed, but the teens escape.
In season 2, Graydon Creed's Friends of Humanity attack mutants, until Wolverine exposes Creed as Sabretooth's son.
In season 1, the Friends of Humanity hunt young Roberto with Sentinel tech, and their leader strikes at Magneto's trial.

raft.k: Outcast mutants living under the city
st: In season 1, the Morlocks kidnap Cyclops and Jean, until Storm beats Callisto and has her rule in Storm's place.
In season 3, the Reavers raid the Morlocks' tunnels and use them as hostages against Wolverine.
In season 4, Wolverine's blood saves young Leech, and Storm hands leadership back to Callisto.
In season 4, Fabian Cortez seizes Magneto's Asteroid M and fires missiles at Earth, until Magneto destroys it.
In season 2, Exodus's Acolytes kidnap Graydon Creed for a trial in their Savage Land haven, until Nightcrawler beats Exodus.
In season 1, Apocalypse turns Archangel and three others into his Horsemen, and the X-Men beat them at Stonehenge.
In season 2, X-Force kills War, and Apocalypse raises the dead Gambit as one of his Horsemen.
Rogue frees Gambit from Apocalypse, whose mind she traps in a crystal.

raft.k: A secret UN program to hunt mutants
st: In season 1, the UN's secret OZT division builds Prime Sentinels with Bastion and Sinister and turns them on mutants worldwide.
Jean collars Bastion, the Prime Sentinels shut down, and Bastion falls when missiles strike Asteroid M.

raft.k: The pure-blood council that rules the vampires
st: The pure-blood elders who rule the vampires rebuke Deacon Frost for stirring up war with humans.
Frost burns Elder Dragonetti in the sunrise, strips the others of power, and uses them in his ritual.

raft.k: The vampire realm ruled by Eli Damaskinos
st: Overlord Eli Damaskinos asks Blade for help against the Reapers, hiding that his own lab made them.
He captures Blade to harvest his blood, but Nyssa turns on him and his son Nomak kills him.

raft.k: A powerful vampire house in Detroit
st: Blade plants Krista Starr inside the House of Chthon, where Marcus Van Sciver runs the Aurora Project.
With Blade's help, Marcus unleashes his virus on the pureblood elders at their conclave.
Howard Saint's mob kills Frank Castle's whole family to avenge his son Bobby.
Castle turns Saint against his wife and Glass, wipes out his men and son John, and blows Saint up.

raft.k: An energy giant with a rig off New Orleans
st: In season 1, Roxxon buries the truth about its rig explosion, until its drilling spreads a deadly energy through New Orleans.
Tandy and Tyrone release the energy safely, Roxxon is blamed, and Scarborough is left trapped in his own mind.

compound.k: Norman Osborn's defense and science company
st: Norman Osborn tests a strength formula to save an Oscorp military contract, then kills the board that votes him out.
Harry, now an Oscorp leader, funds Otto Octavius's fusion machine, which goes wrong at its public demonstration.

compound.k: Norman Osborn's technology company
st: Oscorp takes Peter on as an intern and suits up Spider-Man, and its Project Monolith gateway lets a symbiote through.

compound.k: Harry Osborn's company for young geniuses
st: Harry founds the Worldwide Engineering Brigade to back young geniuses without exploiting them, and invites Jeanne and Lonnie.

compound.k: Earth's mightiest heroes
st: The Avengers split over the Sokovia Accords, and Iron Man helps arrest Otto Octavius.

compound.k: J. Jonah Jameson's New York newspaper
st: J. Jonah Jameson hires Peter to photograph Spider-Man, and the Bugle names the masked killer the Green Goblin.
The Bugle keeps calling Spider-Man a menace, and Jameson gloats when his suit turns up in the trash.
Peter exposes Eddie Brock's faked photos, and Jameson fires Brock and makes Peter a staff photographer.

compound.k: J. Jonah Jameson's New York newspaper
st: In season 1, Peter sells photos to J. Jonah Jameson's Daily Bugle, which calls Spider-Man a menace.

compound.k: J. Jonah Jameson's New York newspaper
st: In season 1, Peter works as a photographer for J. Jonah Jameson's Daily Bugle, which calls Spider-Man a menace.

compound.k: J. Jonah Jameson's New York newspaper
st: In season 1, Peter takes photos for J. Jonah Jameson's Daily Bugle, where Robbie Robertson and Ned Lee work.

compound.k: Nick Fury's spy agency
st: In season 1, Nick Fury's S.H.I.E.L.D. enlists J. Jonah Jameson to stop the Chameleon from killing two diplomats.
In season 4, S.H.I.E.L.D. holds Felicia's father on its Helicarrier until the Chameleon smuggles him out.

compound.k: Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben
st: In season 5, Spider-Man summons the Fantastic Four to the Beyonder's world, where Doom ambushes them and seizes the Thing.

compound.k: Counter-Earth's human freedom fighters
st: John Jameson's human rebels fight the High Evolutionary's rule over Counter-Earth, with Spider-Man and X-51 at their side.

compound.k: A secret military program that studies symbiotes
st: Rex Strickland's Imperium captures and studies symbiotes at a desert base and hunts Eddie and Venom.
Its symbiotes and scientists fight Knull's Xenophages, and the base burns in the final blast.

compound.k: Miguel O'Hara's multiversal society of Spider-People
st: From Nueva York, Miguel O'Hara's Spider-Society guards canon events and hunts Miles when he refuses to let his father die.

compound.k: Charles Xavier's team of mutant heroes
st: Charles recruits young mutants for the CIA, trains them at his mansion, and stops Shaw off Cuba.
Xavier's X-Men take in Logan and Rogue and stop Magneto's machine on Liberty Island.
Stryker raids the school, and the X-Men stop his Cerebro at Alkali Lake as Jean dies holding back the flood.
Cyclops and Xavier die, and Logan and Storm lead the X-Men against Magneto's army on Alcatraz.
In 2023, the last X-Men hide from the Sentinels in a Chinese temple and send Logan's mind back to 1973.
They fall to the Sentinels, but Logan wakes in a new 2023 where the school thrives and the X-Men live.
In 1983, Apocalypse's attack destroys the mansion, and Scott, Jean, Kurt and Ororo become the new X-Men.
The X-Men save a shuttle crew in space, but Jean comes back changed, Raven dies, and the school is renamed for Jean.
Colossus and his trainee Negasonic try to recruit Deadpool, then help him rescue Vanessa from Ajax.
Colossus brings Deadpool in as an X-Men trainee, and his first mission ends in arrest.
By 2029 the X-Men are gone, several killed in one of Xavier's seizures, and Laura knows them from comic books.

compound.k: The U.S. spy agency
st: Agent Moira MacTaggert brings Charles in, and the CIA's Division X recruits young mutants to stop Shaw.
In 1983, CIA agent Moira MacTaggert tracks a cult in Cairo and sees En Sabah Nur wake.

compound.k: Erik's island refuge for mutants
st: Erik's island refuge turns Jean away, and its fighters hunt her in New York, then join the X-Men against the D'Bari.

compound.k: Young mutants held at a secret hospital
st: Five troubled young mutants held at a secret hospital band together, calm the Demon Bear, and walk free.

compound.k: Charles Xavier's team of mutant heroes
st: In season 1, the X-Men take in Jubilee, lose Morph to the Sentinels, and destroy Master Mold with Magneto's help.
In season 2, Scott and Jean marry, and the team saves Xavier and Magneto from Mister Sinister in the Savage Land.
In season 3, Jean becomes the Phoenix and stops D'Ken, then the team fights the Shi'ar Imperial Guard for her life.
In season 4, Morph rejoins the team, and the X-Men help Moira MacTaggert stop her son Proteus.
In season 2, the X-Men clash with Spider-Man at the mansion, and Wolverine joins his hunt for the missing Beast.
In season 5, the X-Men survive the Phalanx, and Xavier, struck down by Gyrich, leaves Earth with Lilandra to heal.
In season 1, Xavier's will puts Magneto in charge of the X-Men, and the team mourns Gambit after Genosha falls.
Fighting Bastion, the X-Men vanish when Asteroid M explodes, scattered across time.
In season 2, the X-Men come home from across time and rebase on Genosha as X-Corp, and Rogue traps Apocalypse.

compound.k: A government team of mutants
st: In season 3, the government's X-Factor, led by Forge, clashes with the X-Men, and Lorna chooses to stay with it.
In season 2, Valerie Cooper's X-Factor hunts runaway young mutants and X-Force, then joins X-Force against X-Corp.

compound.k: Cable's strike team against Apocalypse
st: In season 2, Cable's X-Force hunts Apocalypse's Horsemen and kills War, and Valerie Cooper brands them fugitives.
Jubilee and Sunspot leave, and the rest join X-Factor against X-Corp until Rogue frees them from Apocalypse.

compound.k: Corsair's band of space pirates
st: In season 3, Corsair's space pirates steal the M'Kraan Crystal to trade to D'Ken, then join the fight against him inside it.

compound.k: A vast alien empire
st: In season 3, Lilandra flees her brother D'Ken's rule, and later the Shi'ar put the Dark Phoenix on trial.
In season 5, Lilandra takes the dying Xavier to the Shi'ar homeworld to be healed.
In season 1, at war with the Kree, Empress Lilandra's court splits over her engagement to Xavier.

compound.k: An island nation of mutants
st: In season 1, Genosha lures mutants with promises of a haven and enslaves them to build Sentinels, until the X-Men free them.
In season 5, Magneto gathers his mutant army on Genosha, then calls off his attack when Xavier is struck down.
In season 1, Genosha's mutant council asks Magneto and Rogue to lead it, and the island joins the UN.
Sentinels attack during the gala and kill thousands of Genosha's mutants.
In season 2, Xavier rebases the banned X-Men in Genosha's ruins as X-Corp.

compound.k: Four explorers changed by a cosmic storm
st: Given powers by a cosmic storm, four explorers become the Fantastic Four after a rescue on the Brooklyn Bridge and stop Doom.
Forced by the military to work with Doom, the team beats him, helps the Surfer turn on Galactus, and Reed and Sue wed.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

compound.k: A band of human vampire hunters
st: The Nightstalkers free Blade from the FBI, lose most of their team in a raid, and help kill Drake with the Daystar virus.

compound.k: Stick's order of warriors, enemies of the Hand
st: Stick's Chaste bring Elektra back from death, then drive off the Hand's assassins and shelter Abby.

compound.k: A small law firm in Hell's Kitchen
st: Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson take on clients they believe innocent in Hell's Kitchen, often for free.

compound.k: The rulers of Attilan, a hidden city on the Moon
st: Maximus seizes Attilan in a coup, and the Royal Family is scattered across Hawaii, hunted by his guards.
Reunited, they return to Attilan, lead its people to Earth, and Black Bolt seals Maximus inside as the city is abandoned.

compound.k: Six teens on the run from their parents
st: In season 1, six teens learn their parents in PRIDE kill for Jonah, stop the PRIDE drill, and run when framed for murder.
In season 2, hiding in an old hostel, they fight Jonah and are split up when their parents close in.
With their parents, they banish Morgan le Fay, and their future selves help undo Gert's death.

add_steps: In season 1, the Imperial Guard defends Empress Lilandra's court when Deathbird's followers rise against Xavier.
fixes.why: The Imperial Guard fights Deathbird's supporters at Lilandra's court in X-Men '97 (Lifedeath, Part 2).

add_steps: In 1983, Hank and Raven train the new X-Men against confiscated Sentinels.
fixes.why: X-Men: Apocalypse ends with Beast and Mystique training the X-Men using confiscated Sentinels.
